content: Contact-form-as-a-service failures are often silent: emails routed to spam without any signal to the sender, missing/misconfigured form ID or access key, CORS/Content-Type errors swallowed by a try/catch with no user-facing error state, free-tier submission quota silently exhausted, or a JS error before submit that never triggers the network request at all. Needs both a visible success/error UI state after submit and a way to verify delivery (test submission + checking the inbox/spam) rather than trusting the UI alone.
